sentences.zh: 作为一个独立的决策机构，因为人们一直以来的想法是，你希望由关注数字和经济长期健康的经济学家

sentences.en: He didn't waste any time in starting to badger Powell and the Fed more generally to lower interest interest rates and to sort of serve his goals.
sentences.zh: 来主导美联储的这些决策，而不是由一个只想着连任和政治的总统来主导。

sentences.en: Right, which was very much at odds with the traditional vision of the Fed.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统决定试图罢免美联储理事会的一名成员，这是他对这个国家央行独立性发起的最大胆的攻击。

sentences.en: We've talked about this a lot on the show.
sentences.zh: 今天，本·卡斯特曼讲述了这个故事：特朗普是如何决定通过一位名叫丽莎·库克的经济学教授来走上接管美联储之路的。

sentences.en: As an independent policymaking body, because the thinking has always been, you want economists who are thinking about the numbers and the long-term health of the economy
sentences.zh: 今天是8月27日，星期三。

sentences.en: driving those decisions at the Fed, not a president thinking about re-election and politics.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你在这么短、相对较短的时间里配合采访。

sentences.en: Yeah, the whole idea of Fed independence is this sort of bedrock concept that's clearly not a vision that Trump shares.
sentences.zh: 对啊，美联储独立性的整体概念是一个显而易见的基石，但这显然不是特朗普认同的愿景。

sentences.en: And, you know, pretty quickly, this badgering of Powell turns into real threats to fire him, and he takes real steps in that direction.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，很快地，这种对鲍威尔的纠缠就变成了真正的解雇威胁，并且他在这方面采取了实际行动。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So he's sort of eventually persuaded not to go through with that.
sentences.zh: 所以他最终在某种程度上被说服，没有把这件事贯彻到底。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The thinking is it would be potentially cataclysmic in the markets.
sentences.zh: 大家的想法是，这可能会在市场上引发灾难。

sentences.en: That's the thinking that he appears to have been convinced of that, at least for the time being.
sentences.zh: 这就是他似乎被说服时的想法，至少目前看来是这样。

sentences.en: But he has not given up on this vision of trying to control the Fed and bend it to his will.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有放弃试图控制美联储并让其顺从自己意愿的愿景。

sentences.en: And so he's looking for another way to achieve that.
sentences.zh: 因此，他正在寻找另一种方法来实现这一点。

sentences.en: And that eventually leads him to target the Board of Governors, and specifically to target
sentences.zh: 这最终促使他把目标对准了联邦储备理事会，具体而言是把目标对准了

sentences.en: Lisa Cook.

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 我是韦娜·刘。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》这两款游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.

sentences.en: Ben, once President Trump and those around him decide that they want to try to gain control
sentences.zh: 本，一旦特朗普总统及其身边的人决定要通过针对美联储理事会来试图获得

sentences.en: over the Fed by targeting its Board of Governors, how do they find their way to Lisa Cook?
sentences.zh: 对美联储的控制权，他们是如何找到丽莎·库克的？

sentences.en: So just remember the math here for a minute.
sentences.zh: 所以我们先来捋一捋这里的账目。

sentences.en: Of the seven members of the Board of Governors when Trump takes office, five of them are
sentences.zh: 在特朗普上任时，理事会的七名成员中，有五名是

sentences.en: Biden appointees.
sentences.zh: 拜登任命的。

sentences.en: Two of them were nominated by Trump during his first term.
sentences.zh: 其中两名是特朗普在第一任期内提名的。

sentences.en: One of those positions has already come vacant.
sentences.zh: 其中一个职位已经空缺了。

sentences.en: So now Trump will have three.
sentences.zh: 所以现在特朗普将拥有三个。

sentences.en: To have a majority of the board, he needs a fourth.
sentences.zh: 要获得理事会的多数席位，他需要第四个。

sentences.en: You are good at math.
sentences.zh: 你很擅长数学。

sentences.en: You know, this is why you have me on.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就是为什么你要请我来。

sentences.en: It's the math.
sentences.zh: 这就是数学问题。

sentences.en: So he needs one more.
sentences.zh: 所以他还差一个。

sentences.en: None of those positions are actually coming up anytime very soon.
sentences.zh: 这些职位实际上在短期内都不会空出来。

sentences.en: Right, because the appointments are long.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为任期很长。

sentences.en: The appointments are intentionally long so that they are not subject to political interference.
sentences.zh: 这些任期被刻意设置得很长，这样它们就不会受到政治干预。

sentences.en: So the only way for him to get a majority of the board is to fire someone.
sentences.zh: 所以他获得理事会多数席位的唯一方法就是解雇某人。

sentences.en: And that's not an easy thing to do.
sentences.zh: 而这并不是一件容易的事。

sentences.en: Because under the Federal Reserve Act, which I'm sure you have read many times, under the law that governs the Fed, governors can only be fired for cause.
sentences.zh: 因为根据《联邦储备法》——我确信你已经读过很多遍了——根据管理美联储的法律，理事只能因正当理由被解雇。

sentences.en: And cause generally means dereliction of duty, malfeasance, gross misconduct is pretty significant.
sentences.zh: 而“正当理由”通常意味着玩忽职守、渎职，严重的违法违规行为情况相当重大。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's not meant to be something light.
sentences.zh: 对，这可不是什么轻描淡写的事。

sentences.en: And it's generally somehow related to the job that they have been appointed to do.
sentences.zh: 而且这通常在某种程度上与他们被任命去执行的工作有关。

sentences.en: This is, of course, the battle that's been going on about the possibility of Trump firing Powell, is that he would need cause to oust Powell.
sentences.zh: 当然，这就是关于特朗普可能解雇鲍威尔这一争论一直在发生的原因，即他需要正当理由来赶走鲍威尔。

sentences.en: He generally is not thought to have it.
sentences.zh: 普遍认为他并不具备这样的理由。

sentences.en: So he's looking around at other Fed governors.
sentences.zh: 所以他在环顾其他美联储理事。

sentences.en: Could he find it there?
sentences.zh: 他能在那里找到吗？

sentences.en: Could he find it there?
sentences.zh: 他能在那里找到吗？

sentences.en: And riding to his rescue is Bill Pulte, a man you may have never heard of.
sentences.zh: 而前来解救他的是比尔·普尔特，一个你可能从未听说过的人。

sentences.en: Not until now.
sentences.zh: 直到现在才知道。

sentences.en: Who runs an agency you may not have heard of, or certainly don't spend a lot of time thinking of.
sentences.zh: 他领导着一个你可能没听说过、或者肯定不会花很多时间去考虑的机构。

sentences.en: Which is what?
sentences.zh: 是什么？

sentences.en: Which is the Federal Housing Finance Administration, the FHFA.
sentences.zh: 也就是联邦住房金融局，即 FHFA。

sentences.en: And how does he ride to Trump's rescue here?
sentences.zh: 他是如何在这里解救特朗普的？

sentences.en: So Bill Pulte, despite being in this sort of anonymous agency, has kind of emerged as one of Trump's premier attack dogs, enforcers.
sentences.zh: 所以比尔·普尔特尽管身处这样一个名不见经传的机构，却已经摇身一变，成为特朗普最重要的御用打手和执行者之一。

sentences.en: But in particular, he has used his position as the head of this mortgage agency, which gives him access to all of these records, right?
sentences.zh: 但特别的是，他利用了自己作为这个抵押贷款机构负责人的职位，这让他能够接触到所有这些记录，对吧？

sentences.en: Millions of records on people's mortgages, to mine those records for potentially damaging information against some of Trump's perceived enemies.
sentences.zh: 关于人们抵押贷款的数百万条记录，他从这些记录中挖掘可能对特朗普的某些假想敌不利的信息。

sentences.en: So he accuses Letitia James, who's the New York Attorney General, who helped lead investigations into President Trump's business practices.
sentences.zh: 因此，他指控纽约州总检察长莱蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯，她曾协助领导对特朗普总统商业行为的调查。

sentences.en: He accuses her of mortgage fraud.
sentences.zh: 他指控她犯有抵押贷款欺诈罪。

sentences.en: He does the same against Adam Schiff, senator from California, accuses him of mortgage fraud.
sentences.zh: 他对来自加利福尼亚州的参议员亚当·希夫也做了同样的事情，指控他犯有抵押贷款欺诈。

sentences.en: Schiff helped lead the investigation in the Trump impeachment trial during President Trump's first term.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统的第一任期内，希夫曾协助领导针对特朗普弹劾审判的调查。

sentences.en: And last week, sort of out of nowhere, he does the same to Lisa Cook, to our central character here.
sentences.zh: 而就在上周，仿佛毫无征兆地，他对我们的核心人物丽莎·库克也做了同样的事。

sentences.en: It seems worth noting that both Letitia James and Lisa Cook are black women.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，莱蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯和丽莎·库克都是黑人女性。

sentences.en: In fact, black women who are the first black women to hold their respective jobs.
sentences.zh: 事实上，黑人女性担任各自职位的历史上的首位黑人女性。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: And we don't know why Lisa Cook was targeted or whether race played any role in that.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道丽莎·库克为什么成为目标，也不知道种族是否在其中发挥了任何作用。

sentences.en: We do know that the Trump administration has often gone after people of color as it's been sort of taking the levers of power in government.
sentences.zh: 我们确实知道，特朗普政府在接管政府权力杠杆的过程中，经常针对有色人种。

sentences.en: And what exactly does Bill Pulte accuse Lisa Cook of doing when it comes to mortgages?
sentences.zh: 那么比尔·普尔特究竟指控丽莎·库克在抵押贷款方面做了什么？

sentences.en: So specifically, he says that in 2021, she bought a home in Michigan, where she was a professor at Michigan State,
sentences.zh: 具体来说，他说她在2021年在密歇根州买了一套房子，当时她是密歇根州立大学的教授，

sentences.en: and claims it in mortgage documents as her primary residence.
sentences.zh: 并在抵押贷款文件中声称这是她的主要住所。

sentences.en: Typically, when you buy a home, if it's your primary residence, you can get a lower interest rate on your mortgage.
sentences.zh: 通常当你买房时，如果是你的主要住所，你的抵押贷款可以获得较低的利率。

sentences.en: Right, the bank thinks you're going to be very reliable when it comes to paying for your primary residence.
sentences.zh: 对吧，银行认为你在偿还主要住所的贷款时会非常可靠。

sentences.en: Yes, your primary residence.
sentences.zh: 是的，你的主要住所。

sentences.en: You're not going to risk losing that.
sentences.zh: 你不会冒着失去它的风险。

sentences.en: So typically, you can get a lower interest rate.
sentences.zh: 所以通常情况下，你可以获得较低的利率。

sentences.en: Crucially, we don't know here whether
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，我们在这里并不知道

sentences.en: Lisa Cook did get a lower interest rate, but it seems likely that she did.
sentences.zh: 丽莎·库克是否真的获得了较低的利率，但她很可能是拿到了。

sentences.en: Two weeks later,
sentences.zh: 两周后，

sentences.en: Bill Pulte alleges, she bought another home condo in Atlanta and also claims that in mortgage documents as her primary residence.
sentences.zh: 比尔·普尔特指称，她在亚特兰大又买了一套公寓住宅，并在抵押贷款文件中同样声称那是她的主要住所。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Now, you can only have one primary residence at a time.
sentences.zh: 现在，你一次只能有一个主要住所。

sentences.en: And so the allegation here is that one of those homes could not have been her primary residence, and that therefore that that was a form of mortgage fraud.
sentences.zh: 因此这里的指控是，这两处住宅中有一处不可能成为她的主要住所，因此这是一种抵押贷款欺诈形式。

sentences.en: Certainly doesn't look good, but is it fraud?
sentences.zh: 这当然看起来不太妙，但这真的是欺诈吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it doesn't look good, right?
sentences.zh: 对，这看起来确实不好，对吧？

sentences.en: She's buying two homes in two weeks, claiming the both as her primary residence.
sentences.zh: 她在两周内买了两套房子，都宣称是自己的主要住所。

sentences.en: That doesn't seem great.
sentences.zh: 这听起来不太妙。

sentences.en: But look, we haven't seen the documents here.
sentences.zh: 但你看，我们并没有看到这些文件。

sentences.en: We don't know if there were mitigating circumstances.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道是否存在缓和情节。

sentences.en: We don't know if this was an oversight, a mistake.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道这是否是一次疏忽、一个错误。

sentences.en: And none of this has been adjudicated, right?
sentences.zh: 而且所有这些都还没有经过司法裁决，对吧？

sentences.en: None of this has gone to a court.
sentences.zh: 这些都还没有上法庭。

sentences.en: There's been no evidence presented.
sentences.zh: 还没有出示任何证据。

sentences.en: So we don't know at this stage.
sentences.zh: 所以在这个阶段我们还不知道。

sentences.en: What we don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们所不知道的。

sentences.en: What we don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们所不知道的。

sentences.en: We certainly don't know that it's fraud at this point.
sentences.zh: 我们当然不知道这在目前是否构成欺诈。

sentences.en: What we do know is that President Trump immediately seizes on this as the cause he needs to push out Dr. Cook as a member of the Board of Governors.
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，特朗普总统立即抓住这一点，将其作为他赶走库克博士作为理事会成员所需的正当理由。

sentences.en: Literally, for cause, requires a cause, he says, this is my cause.
sentences.zh: 字面意思上，因正当理由，需要一个正当理由，他说，这就是我的正当理由。

sentences.en: Yeah, initially he calls on her to resign.
sentences.zh: 是的，最初他要求她辞职。

sentences.en: Then he says if she doesn't resign, he'll fire her.
sentences.zh: 然后他说如果她不辞职，他就会解雇她。

sentences.en: And then when she doesn't resign,
sentences.zh: 接着当她拒绝辞职时，

sentences.en: he sends her a letter saying that she is terminated, effective immediately, for cause.
sentences.zh: 他给她写了一封信，称她被解雇了，即刻生效，理由是正当理由。

sentences.en: He accuses her of, quote, deceitful and potentially criminal conduct in a financial matter.
sentences.zh: 他指控她在财务问题上有引述“虚假和潜在的犯罪行为”。

sentences.en: And he says that for those reasons, he's firing her.
sentences.zh: 并且他说出于这些原因，他要解雇她。

sentences.en: And from what you can tell based on your reporting, is the president on strong legal footing here in claiming that this is cause to fire her?
sentences.zh: 根据你的报道来看，总统在声称这是解雇她的正当理由方面，是否站得住脚？

sentences.en: That writing that she has two primary residences and mortgage documents, is that legal justification?
sentences.zh: 即写明她在抵押贷款文件中有两个主要住所，这构成法律依据吗？

sentences.en: So we don't know, but we're going to find out because Lisa Cook says she's not resigning and, in fact, is suing to hold on to her position.
sentences.zh: 所以我们还不知道，但我们会知道的，因为丽莎·库克表示她不会辞职，事实上正在起诉以保住她的职位。

sentences.en: And so this is going to be decided in a court of law.
sentences.zh: 因此这将在法庭上得到裁决。

sentences.en: But we've spent the last 24 hours frantically calling legal experts and lawyers trying to understand this.
sentences.zh: 但我们在过去24小时里一直在疯狂地给法律专家和律师打电话，试图弄明白这一点。

sentences.en: And they say basically, probably not.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上说，可能不会。

sentences.en: Trump probably does not have particularly strong legal argument here.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在这里可能没有特别坚实的法律论据。

sentences.en: This involves private conduct from before she was a Fed governor.
sentences.zh: 这涉及到她成为美联储理事之前发生的私人行为。

sentences.en: It hasn't been tested in a court of law.
sentences.zh: 这还没有经受过法庭的检验。

sentences.en: But she now serves in a job where a big part of her role is to help set interest rates that include mortgage rates.
sentences.zh: 但她现在的工作中，很大一部分职责是帮助制定包括抵押贷款利率在内的利率。

sentences.en: So you can see a thread of a connection there.
sentences.zh: 所以你能看出其中有一条联系的线索。

sentences.en: Whether that holds legally, we'll see.
sentences.zh: 这在法律上是否站得住脚，我们拭目以待。

sentences.en: Again, certainly optically, right, it's not a good look.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，从表面外观来看，对吧，这确实不太好看。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯嗯。

sentences.en: But as you say,
sentences.zh: 但正如你所说，

sentences.en: she is determined to stay in this job.
sentences.zh: 她决心留在这个岗位上。

sentences.en: So putting the legal debate aside for just a moment,
sentences.zh: 所以先把法律辩论放一边一会儿，

sentences.en: I'm curious as a student of the Fed and the American economy, what you have made of this firing, this saga.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，作为美联储和美国经济的研究者，你对这次解雇、这场风波有什么看法？

sentences.en: What has just been your gut reaction to it?
sentences.zh: 你对它的第一直觉反应是什么？

sentences.en: So look, we can have the legal debate and the legal debate will play itself out, but I don't think we should be naive here, right?
sentences.zh: 所以你看，我们可以进行法律辩论，法律辩论也会顺其自然地发展，但我不认为我们在这里应该天真，对吧？

sentences.en: This wasn't a general crackdown on mortgage fraud that happened to catch up Lisa Cook, right?
sentences.zh: 这不是碰巧查到了丽莎·库克的打击抵押贷款欺诈的普遍行动，对吧？

sentences.en: This was a targeted effort by the White House to find somebody on the board that they could find cause to fire so that the president can take control of the Fed.
sentences.zh: 这是白宫的一项有针对性的努力，旨在寻找理事会中他们能找到解雇理由的某个人，以便总统能够控制美联储。

sentences.en: That's what's going on here.
sentences.zh: 这才是这里正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: And as you and I have talked about many times, the independence of the Fed is really central to the functioning of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 正如你和我多次讨论过的那样，美联储的独立性对于美国经济和全球金融系统的运作确实至关重要。

sentences.en: economy and the global financial system.
sentences.zh: 经济和全球金融系统。

sentences.en: And this is the clearest, most present danger to that that we've seen in decades.
sentences.zh: 这是我们几十年来见过的对此最清晰、最现实的威胁。

sentences.en: That said, we have heard a lot of doomsday scenarios articulated since the beginning of this administration.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，自从本届政府上台以来，我们已经听到过很多末日论调被表达出来。

sentences.en: Tariffs were going to be the ruin of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 关税将成为美国经济的毁灭。

sentences.en: economy.
sentences.zh: 经济。

sentences.en: That really hasn't come to pass.
sentences.zh: 那实际上并没有发生。

sentences.en: Isn't it very possible he's going to eventually take over the Fed and everything's going to be fine?
sentences.zh: 难道他最终接管美联储而一切都会安然无恙，这不是很可能的吗？

sentences.en: I mean, look, Michael, I came in today waiting for some big reaction in the financial markets.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，听着，迈克尔，我今天来的时候还在等待金融市场有什么大的反应。

sentences.en: We didn't get it.
sentences.zh: 我们没有等到。

sentences.en: Markets look fine.
sentences.zh: 市场看起来很好。

sentences.en: And this isn't the first time I think that you and I have sat together ready for a big reaction in the financial markets that did not come.
sentences.zh: 我想这已经不是你和我第一次坐在一起准备迎接金融市场的巨大反应却未能等到了。

sentences.en: So markets aren't everything, right?
sentences.zh: 所以市场并不是全部，对吧？

sentences.en: But that is an indication that certainly many investors don't think that this is an imminent disaster.
sentences.zh: 但这表明，当然许多投资者并不认为这是一场迫在眉睫的灾难。

sentences.en: And as you say, the economy has so far held up more or less fine, right?
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，经济到目前为止总体上还算撑得过去，对吧？

sentences.en: There are cracks here and there, right?
sentences.zh: 这里或那里有一些裂痕，对吧？

sentences.en: But it's not like we're plunging off a cliff.
sentences.zh: 但也不是说我们在向悬崖下坠落。

sentences.en: So we don't know where that heads.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不知道这会走向何方。

sentences.en: But I do think there is something important about the idea that we have data that we can trust,
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，有一个观点很重要，那就是我们拥有可以信赖的数据，

sentences.en: that we have institutions that operate with a measure of independence, and we wouldn't expect to see the impact of these kinds of assaults on those institutions today, tomorrow,
sentences.zh: 我们拥有以一定程度的独立性运作的机构，我们不会期望在今天、明天甚至明年就看到这种针对这些机构的攻击所产生的影响，对吧？

sentences.en: even next year, right?
sentences.zh: 这些是花了一代人时间才建立起来的东西，其侵蚀的影响可能需要时间才会显现出来，但这并不意味着这些影响

sentences.en: These are things that have taken a generation to build up, and it could take time for the effects of their erosion to show through, but that doesn't mean that those effects
sentences.zh: 不存在。

sentences.en: are not real.
sentences.zh: 并非真实的。

sentences.en: I wonder
sentences.zh: 我在想

sentences.en: what Professor
sentences.zh: 莉萨·库克教授

sentences.en: Lisa Cook would think about all of this.
sentences.zh: 会对这一切作何感想。

sentences.en: Her most important research,
sentences.zh: 她最重要的研究，

sentences.en: Ben, as you said,
sentences.zh: 本，正如你所说，

sentences.en: was around what happens when you don't feel safe and secure in your position, when your government doesn't protect you.
sentences.zh: 围绕着这样一种情况展开：当你对自己的职位感到不够安全感和保障，当你的政府无法保护你时，会发生什么。

sentences.en: One fairly indisputable fact in this moment is that people who work for the United States government don't feel safe and secure
sentences.zh: 目前一个相当无可争辩的事实是，为美国政府工作的人并不感到安全

sentences.en: in their work.
sentences.zh: 和有保障。

sentences.en: And I wonder what Professor Cook would say
sentences.zh: 我想知道库克教授会怎么说

sentences.en: about the implications of that.
sentences.zh: 关于这其中的影响。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, a couple of people have made the point to me that there is an irony here that in some ways the person who has the most insight into this moment in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，有些人向我指出，这里存在一个讽刺之处，那就是在某些方面，对美国当前局势洞察最深的人

sentences.en: economy
sentences.zh: 经济

sentences.en: at least at the Fed
sentences.zh: 至少在美联储内部

sentences.en: is Dr. Lisa Cook.
sentences.zh: 是莉萨·库克博士。

sentences.en: Not only when it comes to maybe the fear that government employees are feeling, but the fear that people living in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 不仅体现在政府雇员可能感受到的恐惧上，还体现在目前生活在美国的部分民众身上

sentences.en: in some cases are feeling right now.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，他们此刻正感受到的恐惧。

sentences.en: That people in immigrant communities, that people who feel threatened in different ways may be feeling right now.
sentences.zh: 移民社区的人们，以及那些在不同方面感到受威胁的人，此刻可能正在感受到的恐惧。

sentences.en: That could have a real economic impact that the Fed might really like to understand right now as they're setting policy.
sentences.zh: 这可能会产生真正的经济影响，而美联储在制定政策时可能会非常希望能理解这一点。

sentences.en: If this firing goes through, they'll have to have that conversation without the benefit of the expertise of Lisa Cook.
sentences.zh: 如果这次解雇通过了，他们在进行讨论时，就无法借助莉萨·库克的专业知识了。

sentences.en: Well, Ben.
sentences.zh: 好吧，本。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll have a majority very shortly, so that'll be great.
sentences.zh: 我们很快就会占多数，所以那会很棒。

sentences.en: During a cabinet meeting on Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 在周二的一次内阁会议上，

sentences.en: President Trump predicted that he would soon control a majority of the Federal Reserve's
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统预测他很快将控制美联储的多数席位

sentences.en: Board of Governors and would use that power to lower interest rates.
sentences.zh: 联邦储备委员会，并将利用这一权力来降低利率。

sentences.en: Once we have a majority, housing is going to swing and it's going to be great.
sentences.zh: 一旦我们有了多数席位，房地产市场就会腾飞，那将是极好的。

sentences.en: People are paying too high an interest rate.
sentences.zh: 人们支付的利率太高了。

sentences.en: That's the only problem with housing.
sentences.zh: 这是房地产唯一的棘手问题。

sentences.en: And he suggested that he plans to move quickly to nominate a replacement for Lisa Cook, raising the possibility that Trump may name
sentences.zh: 他暗示自己计划迅速采取行动，提名莉萨·库克的继任者，这就引发出一种可能性：特朗普可能会在库克仍坚守岗位并抗争被解雇的努力时，

sentences.en: Cook's successor even as she remains in the job and fights his efforts to fire her.
sentences.zh: 就任命她的继任者。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 周二，以色列军方表示，其周一对加沙一家医院造成20人死亡（其中5人为记者）的致命袭击，目的是摧毁

sentences.en: Drawing reactions from across the country.
